title: The CyberUnicorn console waits out a slow boot instead of calling the board deaf

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'The CyberUnicorn is printing but not answering commands' after a power cycle, then 'Delay the start up screen on the computer by a second so it syncs up better with the CYD startup.' and 'there is no speaker. Make the light flash a bunch'.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: with a stuck card reader the board's startup hat probe ran each I2C address into Wire's 50 ms timeout, six scans deep, so its command task started after the console's fixed 40 s wait. Firmware 0.1.2 bounds that probe (hellofrequencylab/projects); this side keeps asking while the board is still printing (up to 90 s, until it has been quiet 5 s), shows 'Stuck, unplug for 10 s' when hat.probe reports i2c_stuck, starts its boot animation 1 s after the port opens to match the board's, and the tap copy says the light flashes (the board has no speaker).

verify.note: Fails when the boot wait loses its print-extended cap, the boot animation stops waiting for the board, the copy promises a beep again, or HatProbe drops i2c_stuck.
